# Health

Operational readiness and service health endpoints.

## `GET /healthz`

Get health

- Operation ID: `getHealth`

### Responses

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | The request has succeeded. |
| `400` | The server could not understand the request due to invalid syntax. |
| `401` | Access is unauthorized. |
| `429` | Client error |
| `500` | Server error |
